title: Modular functions and transcendence questions
note: Sb. Math. 187(9) (1996), 1319-1348 (Russian original Mat. Sb. 187(9) (1996), 65-96). Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1070/SM1996v187n09ABEH000158) (2026-11-28).
